title: Printed lab jigs: NMR coil former and a three-electrode cell lid
blurb: Two printed parts whose job is to make a measurement repeatable. The coil former fixes the winding window, so the inductance the noise budget assumes is the one on the bench: 38.5 x 2.7 mm gives 546 turns and 2.52 mH against the 2.53 the design wanted. A single layer cannot get there - 2900 turns and 1.2 m. The cell lid holds the electrode spacing, which is what sets the uncompensated resistance.
